snippet.title: Cresata | Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Betrayed. Imprisoned. Left to die.
Following a treacherous rebellion, Phaedon of Arsica is imprisoned and left for dead. Freed by a twist of fate, he now hunts down those who betrayed him and his homeland.

Inspired by classics such as Strider and Castlevania, with a hint of modern retro platformers like Celeste, Cresata is a side-scrolling action platformer that’s easy to pick up but hard to master. 

Coming 2027 to PC, PlayStation5 and Xbox Series X|S.
